name: Hardrock 100 (Clockwise)
blurb: 100+ miles, 33,000+ ft of vert, 13 passes above 12,000 ft, and a painted rock waiting in Silverton. Estimated finish: Thursday.

name: Hardrock 100 (Counter-Clockwise)
blurb: The exact same 33,000+ ft of San Juan suffering, starting with Cunningham Gulch instead of KT so your quads are surprised differently.

name: Imogene Pass Run
blurb: 17.1 miles from Ouray (7,811 ft) up and over 13,114 ft Imogene Pass to Telluride. At least the second half is downhill — until your quads explode.

name: Telluride Mountain Run (40M)
blurb: 40 rugged miles circling the box canyon, highlighted by the 'Mile and a Half of Sky' ridge above 13,000 ft where gravity becomes optional.

name: Rundola
blurb: Up the Telluride Trail and gondola corridor to San Sophia Station (10,540 ft). You get to ride the gondola back down, which is the only civilized part.

name: Deep Creek Trail Half Marathon
blurb: 13.1 miles of golden-aspen singletrack from Last Dollar Road across Deep Creek, Mill Creek, Waterline, and Jud Wiebe down to Oak Street.

name: Kendall Mountain Run
blurb: Born from a 1908 Silverton bar bet: climb nearly 4,000 ft up Kendall Mountain to 13,066 ft and sprint back to Memorial Park.

name: San Juan Solstice 50
blurb: 50-mile counter-clockwise high-alpine tour out of Lake City touching the Continental Divide above 13,300 ft. Bring a rain shell.

name: Silverton Alpine 50K
blurb: High-altitude Alpine Loop tour linking Howardsville, Eureka, Animas Forks, and 12,930 ft California Pass.

name: Ouray 50
blurb: 52 miles and ~24,000 ft of vertical around the Ouray amphitheater, featuring Chief Ouray Mine and the Bridge of Heaven.

name: Blue Lakes & Yankee Boy Classic
blurb: Sneffels Wilderness showcase: climb past turquoise Blue Lakes over 13,000 ft Blue Lakes Pass into Yankee Boy Basin.
